source.extractionTool: pdftotext (poppler), -enc UTF-8, -layout mode; pdfplumber for raised/lowered characters (powers, subscripts, degree signs) and positions; pdfplumber page renders to check equation-editor content
source.notes: No official marking scheme is published with this paper; questions carry no official answer. From the CISCE Archive Library ICSE 2024 question-paper bundle. Paper code "T24 511" printed on every page; 'Maximum Marks: 80', 'Time allowed: Two and half hours'; 12 printed pages. Section A (40 marks, compulsory): Question 1 = 15 objective items under a single [15] (1 mark each; (xiii) is assertion-reason), Questions 2 and 3 split at each (i)/(ii)/(iii) with printed marks. Section B (40 marks): 'Attempt any four questions' from Questions 4-10 (10 marks each); a pick-4-of-7 choice, not an OR pair, so choiceGroup is not used and all seven are included; the pack's marks total (110) therefore exceeds maxMarks (80) by design. (a)/(b)/(c) items inside a sub-part share one printed mark and are kept together. Notation: powers, the subscript in Tₙ and degree signs are raised/lowered characters that pdftotext flattens; they were checked with pdfplumber and rebuilt (flagged MEDIUM). Much of the equation-editor content (matrices, trigonometric expressions, stacked fractions, bold equations such as Q6(i)) is garbled in the text layer (Cambria Math glyphs doubled or mis-mapped, matrix brackets lost); it was rebuilt from glyph positions and checked against a render of each page, and flagged. Q1(viii) option (d) prints '(1/a + 7⁷)' with a raised 7 (apparently a typesetting slip); reproduced as printed. The rupee sign is a Rupee-font glyph that extracts as '`'; normalised to ₹. Tables are reproduced as text rows. No cognitive-level tags are printed on this paper.
source.usage: Official CISCE board examination paper from the CISCE Archive Library (cisce.org/archive-library); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to the original. Figures are not reproduced.
